primitives.name: Ancestral Confidence Graph
primitives.verbatim_quote: The family in one page Garrett's known ancestry divides into four major research branches: Baxley-Barclay and Daughtrey-Biddy on the paternal side; Schumacher-Apfel and Moore-Lawrence-Lance-Ingmire on the maternal side.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'V': 'Set of ancestral nodes (individuals)', 'E': 'Set of directed edges (parent-child relationships)', 'C(v)': 'Confidence score for node v ∈ V, dimensionless'}
primitives.assumptions: Each branch represents a distinct ancestral lineage with independent evolutionary paths.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When C(v) < 0.5, the node is classified as hypothesis or open.

layer2.mapping: Directed graph structure maps to Bayesian network with conditional probability tables derived from historical records.

primitives.name: Geographic Transition Probability
primitives.verbatim_quote: Branch Verified anchor Geographic pattern Deepest responsible status Baxley-Barclay Jim Baxley -> James Leland + Orveda (probable) Texas / Florida; earlier southern U.S.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P_{ij}': 'Transition probability from location i to j, dimensionless', 'L_v': 'Location of node v, categorical', 'T_v': 'Time of node v, temporal units'}
primitives.assumptions: Migration follows a Markovian process with time-dependent transition probabilities.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When P_{ij} < 0.1, the transition is considered unlikely or unverified.

layer2.mapping: Probability kernel derived from historical migration data and census records.
layer2.telemetry: Migration path frequency and temporal alignment with historical events

primitives.name: Evidence Verification Standard
primitives.verbatim_quote: The governing rule Confidence belongs to the evidence - not to Ancestry, FamilySearch, Find a Grave, another user's tree, or this dossier.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'E': 'Evidence strength, dimensionless', 'R': 'Record type (obituary, certificate, etc.), categorical', 'S': 'Source reliability, dimensionless'}
primitives.assumptions: Evidence quality is independent of platform or contributor bias.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When E < 0.6, the claim is marked as probable or hypothesis.

layer2.mapping: Evidence strength maps to likelihood function in Bayesian updating framework.
layer2.telemetry: Number of independent corroborating sources per claim
